name: Game assets
description: Images, sound, music, voices and 3D models for games, with your own keys.

services.name: Audio
services.description: ElevenLabs · Sound effects, voices and music

settings.name: azure_deployment
settings.label: Deployment
settings.placeholder: the deployment's name in Azure (often the model's, e.g. gpt-image-2.5-sunburst)

tools.name: make_image
tools.description: Make an image with gpt-image and save it as a PNG in the project. Use for game sprites, icons, textures and concept art: describe subject, style, colours and framing in detail. Returns the image so you can check it and try again. If the image is to become a 3D model (model_from_image), set for_3d and draw it for that: one subject, whole and centred, a front or three-quarter view, even lighting, a plain background; characters in a T-pose or A-pose with arms away from the body and feet showing.

params.name: prompt
params.description: What to draw, in detail: subject, style, colours, framing.

params.name: size
params.description: Pixel size (square, landscape, portrait). Default square.

params.name: quality
params.description: Higher costs more. Default medium.

params.name: transparent
params.description: A transparent background, for sprites and icons.

params.name: for_3d
params.description: The image is to become a 3D model: the pack adds what makes a good source (whole subject, centred, even light, plain background, T-pose for characters).

params.name: name
params.description: File name to save as, without extension (default: from the prompt).

tools.cost: about $0.01 to $0.25 an image, by size and quality

tools.name: edit_image
tools.description: Change an existing image in the project with gpt-image and save the result as a new PNG: recolour a sprite, add or remove something, make a variation, restyle. Give more images (comma-separated) to use the rest as references. Returns the image.

params.name: image
params.description: The image to change, a path in the project (PNG, JPEG or WebP); more, comma-separated, are references.

params.name: prompt
params.description: What to change, in detail.

params.name: mask
params.description: Optional: a PNG the same size as the image whose transparent pixels mark where to change.

params.name: size
params.description: Pixel size. Default: as the image.

params.name: quality
params.description: Higher costs more. Default medium.

params.name: transparent
params.description: A transparent background.

params.name: name
params.description: File name to save as, without extension (default: the image's name with -edit).

tools.cost: about $0.01 to $0.25 an image, by size and quality

tools.name: sound_effect
tools.description: Make a sound effect with ElevenLabs and save it as an MP3 in the project: footsteps, explosions, UI clicks, ambience. Describe the sound plainly ("a short metallic coin pickup chime").

params.name: prompt
params.description: The sound, described.

params.name: seconds
params.description: Length, 0.5 to 30 seconds (default: chosen from the prompt).

params.name: loop
params.description: Make it loop seamlessly (ambience, engines).

params.name: name
params.description: File name to save as, without extension.

tools.name: voice_line
tools.description: Speak a line with an ElevenLabs voice and save it as an MP3 in the project, for dialogue and narration. Audio tags in brackets set delivery, e.g. "[whispers] Over here." Use list_voices to pick a voice.

params.name: text
params.description: What to say.

params.name: voice
params.description: A voice id from list_voices (default: the one set in Settings).

params.name: name
params.description: File name to save as, without extension.

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: List the ElevenLabs voices this account can use (id, name, accent, age, use), for voice_line.

tools.name: music
tools.description: Make a music track with ElevenLabs and save it as an MP3 in the project: describe genre, mood, instruments, tempo. Note: ElevenLabs' terms limit music in games to plans that include it; check before shipping.

params.name: prompt
params.description: The music, described.

params.name: seconds
params.description: Length, 3 to 600 seconds (default 30).

params.name: instrumental
params.description: No vocals.

params.name: name
params.description: File name to save as, without extension.

tools.name: model_from_text
tools.description: Make a 3D model (GLB, textured) with Tripo from a description and save it in the project, with a preview image you can look at. Takes a minute or a few. Describe one object: shape, style, materials; for a character, say T-pose or A-pose (better to rig and animate).

params.name: prompt
params.description: The object, described: shape, style, materials.

params.name: faces
params.description: Most faces the mesh may have (lower for games and mobile).

params.name: texture_quality
params.description: Texture detail. Default standard.

params.name: pbr
params.description: PBR materials.

params.name: name
params.description: File name to save as, without extension.

tools.name: model_from_image
tools.description: Make a 3D model (GLB, textured) with Tripo from an image in the project and save it, with a preview image you can look at. Takes a minute or a few. Works best from one whole subject, centred, on a plain background, in even light, seen from the front or three-quarters; characters in a T-pose or A-pose. Making the image first? Use make_image with for_3d.

params.name: image
params.description: The image, a path in the project (PNG or JPEG, up to 20 MB).

params.name: faces
params.description: Most faces the mesh may have (lower for games and mobile).

params.name: texture_quality
params.description: Texture detail. Default standard.

params.name: pbr
params.description: PBR materials.

params.name: name
params.description: File name to save as, without extension (default: the image's name).
